name: control-room-sidebar
description: The Control Room panel as a sidebar view: it keeps its place while you work in the editor.

commands.title: Control Room (sidebar): Choose which session to talk to
Control Room (sidebar): Resume a Claude session in a terminal
Control Room (sidebar): Install the session-start watch hook

controlRoomSidebar.logPath.description: Where chat.jsonl lives. Empty means every control-room* folder in the workspace is offered as a room the view can switch to; setting it pins the view to one log.

controlRoomSidebar.mirrorEditorChat.description: Copy the Claude tab's conversation into the room, so the view holds both sides rather than only what was typed in it. Mirrored lines are marked and are never answered a second time.

enumDescriptions: Run it with hideFromUser: the process starts and no terminal is surfaced at all.
Open it as an editor tab rather than in the terminal view.
Open it in the terminal view at the bottom, unfocused.
controlRoomSidebar.startTerminal.markdownDescription: Where the terminal goes when the room starts a Claude session for you. `hidden` keeps it out of sight; if no session appears, the room offers to show it, because hiding it hides "you are not logged in" too.
